pending_commit.commit_message: shill: cellular: drop 'universal' in cellular capability Given that those legacy cellular capability classes have been removed, it's no longer necessary to keep 'universal' in the naming of the remaining cellular capability classes, which are renamed in this CL as follows: CellularCapabilityUniversal -> CellularCapability3gpp CellularCapabilityUniversalCdma -> CellularCapabilityCdma This CL is generated with the following commands: sed -i \ -e 's/CapabilityUniversalCdma/CapabilityCdma/g' \ -e 's/CAPABILITY_UNIVERSAL_CDMA/CAPABILITY_CDMA/g' \ -e 's/capability_universal_cdma/capability_cdma/g' \ -e 's/CapabilityUniversal/Capability3gpp/g' \ -e 's/CAPABILITY_UNIVERSAL/CAPABILITY_3GPP/g' \ -e 's/capability_universal/capability_3gpp/g' \ -e 's/kTypeUniversalCdma/kTypeCdma/gI' \ -e 's/kTypeUniversal/kType3gpp/gI' \ $(git ls-files '*.h' '*.cc') BUILD.gn git mv cellular/cellular_capability_{universal,3gpp}.h git mv cellular/cellular_capability_{universal,3gpp}.cc git mv cellular/cellular_capability_{universal,3gpp}_test.cc git mv cellular/cellular_capability_{universal_,}cdma.h git mv cellular/cellular_capability_{universal_,}cdma.cc git mv cellular/cellular_capability_{universal_,}cdma_test.cc git cl format BUG=None TEST=Run unit tests. cryptohome: Fix error code on non-existing chall-resp mount Return CRYPTOHOME_ERROR_ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND from MountEx requests of KEY_TYPE_CHALLENGE_RESPONSE when the home directory doesn't exist and the request doesn't have the |create| field. This is important, since Chrome, even when signing the user in for the first time on the device, sends the first MountEx *without* the |create| field. Chrome then repeats this request *with* the |create| field, but only if the first request returned the non-fatal CRYPTOHOME_ERROR_ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND error. This CL simply aligns the cryptohomed's challenge-response mount behavior with the existing and correct password-based mount behavior. BUG=chromium:842791 TEST=tast run $IP hwsec.ChallengeResponseMount Change-Id: Iaacafc575a16b127171dad811548a57b27436748 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1678657 Tested-by: Maksim Ivanov <emaxx@chromium.org> Commit-Ready: Maksim Ivanov <emaxx@chromium.org> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Ryo Hashimoto <hashimoto@chromium.org>

mesa: explicitly use shared libgcc. For clang toolchain, we are changing the default for unwinder library from shared library to static library. Since mesa is explicitly requesting the libgcc library, let's explicitly request the share library version to keep the old behavior. There is no functional change here. It just allows us to change the default. Also note that, for Chrome OS, libgcc is mostly not used. It has been replaced by llvm/compiler-rt. The only remaining part in use from libgcc is libgcc_eh (for unwinding). BUG=chromium:972454 TEST=None. No functional change.
